entities.summary: Tadayoshi Okura (b. 1985-05-16, Osaka) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Osaka and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
